items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Well sure, you know Lloyd Price, stuff from there, you know that. That's a big name, man.

ctx.x: Joe used to have a, I believe he had a chauffeur and a big Cadillac, big, big guy like that, as I remember it, when I'd go there. I didn't go after him.
Well sure, you know Lloyd Price, stuff from there, you know that. That's a big name, man. Lloyd Price. Fat Domino, all them bars right there. He was Dewdrop.
